info.cls_ename: RMIT-FCU 2+2 Bachelor's Program in Business and Innovation

description.describe_ch: This course aims to introduce you to the workings of the domestic economy and its effects on the business environment; to provide you with analytical skills which will assist you in identifying the current state of the economy and likely future developments in the economy; to enable you to examine critically the effects of actual and projected macroeconomic policies; and to foster in you the ability to express clearly your understanding of macroeconomic events both domestically, and in the broader Asia-Pacific region. The course also aims to help you to understand how current economic developments impact on organizations and on you as a participant in the economy.
description.describe_eh: This course aims to introduce you to the workings of the domestic economy and its effects on the business environment; to provide you with analytical skills which will assist you in identifying the current state of the economy and likely future developments in the economy; to enable you to examine critically the effects of actual and projected macroeconomic policies; and to foster in you the ability to express clearly your understanding of macroeconomic events both domestically, and in the broader Asia-Pacific region. The course also aims to help you to understand how current economic developments impact on organizations and on you as a participant in the economy.

gradeRuleDescribe.tpa_score_new:
1. The make-up tests are given to the students who have either the justification or the written request for the absence of midterm or final exam. If the students do not have the reasonable justification for the absence, the maximum score of the make-up test is 60.
  2. The students get failed if any cheating behavior or plagiarism occurs in the course.

gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
1. Students are expected to attend classes on time. If you are unable to attend, please follow the school's designated leave procedures.
2. During class, avoid unrelated conversations or activities. To maintain a respectful atmosphere, mobile devices must be silenced. Also, wearing headphones is not permitted during lectures. 
3. Note-taking with devices is allowed. 
4. Regularly check your school email and log in to iLearn for updates and messages related to this course.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol_en:
1. Students are expected to attend all lectures.
2. I will also encourage you to take your own lecture notes in class, and that will be helpful on your self-learning.
3. Notice that I will take attendance almost every class. The amount of the extra bonus that I give to students depends on the attendance record.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem: Visit my office (Room 921) during my office hours for questions. Also, you are encouraged to email me (khchin@fcu.edu.tw) to schedule a meeting.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem_en:
1. All the course materials are provided on iLearn platform, please take advantage of them for self-learning.
2. Please review the lecture note before you attend the class.
3. Please remember to attend TA review session, in which TA will provide students a lot of practice questions.
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno:
Integrity is fundamental in learning. Cheating, plagiarism, or assisting others in assignments, quizzes, or exams will result in a zero score. Repeat offenses will be handled according to university disciplinary procedures. Grading rules include:
For exams: Cheating during quizzes, midterm and final exams, including copying or using unauthorized materials, is prohibited. 
For attendance: Only the student themselves can respond to any forms of roll-call or sign-in for in-class exercises to be considered valid.
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno_en:
1. Regardign the homework assignment, please do not copy-and-paste any content, figure or anything written by your classmates or someone else.
2. Your score is counted as zero if any cheating behavior during the midterm or final exam is occurred.
3. Please attend the class on time and please do not skip or leave the class earlier.
